# Loading the necessary R packages
```{r}
pacman::p_load(sf, spdep, tmap, tidyverse, knitr)
```

# 4 Spatial Weights and Applications

## 4.1 Getting the Data Into R Environment
```{r}
hunan <- st_read(dsn = "hands-on_ex4_data", layer = "Hunan")

hunan2012 <- read_csv("hands-on_ex4_data/Hunan_2012.csv")

hunan <- left_join(hunan,hunan2012) %>%
  select(1:4, 7, 15)
```

## 4.2 Visualising Regional Development Indicator
```{r}
basemap <- tm_shape(hunan) +
  tm_polygons() +
  tm_text("NAME_3", size=0.5)

gdppc <- qtm(hunan, "GDPPC") +
  tm_layout(
    legend.position = c("left", "bottom"))
tmap_arrange(basemap, gdppc, asp=1, ncol=2)
```
